summary_en: Kyocera tendered 53,681,800 KDDI shares (1.41% of KDDI shares outstanding) at ¥2,325/share to KDDI's self-tender offer, generating ¥124,810,185,000 in gross proceeds. Kyocera's KDDI stake falls from 14.77% to 13.36%. Settlement scheduled 1 July 2026. Kyocera to record ¥121.6B investment gain.
title_en: Notice Regarding Results of Kyocera's Tender Submission to KDDI Corporation's Self-Share Public Tender Offer
translation_en_brief:
On 11 June 2026, Kyocera announced that it had successfully tendered shares in KDDI Corporation's self-share public tender offer (公開買付け). Kyocera applied to sell 53,763,400 KDDI shares, of which 53,681,800 shares were accepted for purchase at ¥2,325 per share, generating total proceeds of ¥124,810,185,000. The tender period ran from 13 May to 9 June 2026, with settlement commencing 1 July 2026.

As a result of this transaction, Kyocera's ownership stake in KDDI decreased from 562,133,600 shares (14.77% of KDDI shares outstanding, excluding treasury stock) to 508,451,800 shares (13.36%). In Kyocera's individual financial statements for the fiscal year ending March 2027, the company expects to record an investment securities gain of approximately ¥121.6 billion. Under IFRS for consolidated reporting, the gain will be classified as other comprehensive income rather than operating profit, as the KDDI shares are measured at fair value through other comprehensive income.
